notes: You can put an utang on different terms — spread what is owed over more months without moving the payment day. The old terms stay on the record.
A delivery order can now be given a discount.
The counter now names each discount the way the receipt does, instead of showing one lumped total.
On the delivery screen, the total and "Save and print note" stay in view no matter how many lines the load has.
Counter is now first in the sidebar, and Dashboard last.
The search box says Ctrl+K — the key this keyboard actually has — and the arrow keys move through the results.
